title: sentinel-bridge-for-shadow-stability-and-auto-revert
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Problem: We lack a unified mechanism to measure subtle quality regressions surfaced only by shadow traffic or A/B cohorts. Current canary rollouts rely on coarse token-level metrics and separate eval runs; there is no bridged signal that ties runtime outputs to curated golden prompts with adaptive thresholds. This ticket implements a 'Sentinel Bridge' that connects runtime traffic (canary/shadow/A-B) to eval scorecards and powers an automated, hysteresis-aware rollback/orchestration flow.

Goals:
- Ensure regressions detectable in shadow traffic are correlated to curated prompt sets (golden dataset) within 5 minutes of signal emergence.
- Provide a weighted scorecard that tracks per-prompt and cohort-level deltas, using fingerprinting to avoid noisy duplicates.
- Implement an auto-revert flow that triggers only when degradation exceeds both short-term and medium-term thresholds (to avoid flapping).
- Expose dashboard and alerts in Console and wire metrics to PagerDuty for P1 regressions.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not implement new model selection/routing policies beyond triggering existing rollback APIs.
- This ticket does not change inference runtime kernels or quantization configs; it consumes runtime metrics and outputs control decisions.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Sentinel Bridge ingests shadowed responses and maps them to golden prompts with >=95% coverage for golden prompt fingerprints present in traffic.
2) Scorecard computes weighted delta scores per-prompt and aggregated cohort scores every 1 minute.
3) Auto-revert pipeline will mark a canary for rollback if: (a) 1-minute rolling delta > 7% AND (b) 30-minute sustained median delta > 3% across at least two scorecard dimensions.
4) Dashboards show per-prompt histograms, top regressors, and a timeline of decision triggers.
5) End-to-end integration test in staging that introduces synthetic regressions flips a staged canary and triggers an automated rollback in under 8 minutes.
6) Playbook documented and runbook added to Confluence.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (staging): deploy Sentinel Bridge consumer to shadow cluster; enable passive scorecards; no automated reverts. Run 2 weeks of drift detection tests using synthetic perturbations (text corruption, hallucination injections).
Phase 2 (limited-production): enable automated alerting and a dry-run decision engine that logs would-have-rollbacks; monitor false positives for 72 hours.
Phase 3 (gradual enable): enable auto-revert for low-risk customer segments behind a feature flag; observe 1 month before enabling broader cohorts.
Rollback Hysteresis: require both an immediate short-window spike and a sustained medium-window signal; add cooldown window of 60 minutes post-rollback before re-evaluating the same model.
Feature Flags: runtime.flag.sentinel_bridge_autorevert, runtime.flag.sentinel_bridge_scorecard_verbose
metrics_and_alerts:
Primary metrics: aggregate weighted_score_delta, per-prompt delta, cohort-risk-score, fingerprint-coverage.
SLOs/Thresholds: weighted_score_delta should not exceed 7% spike on 1-minute windows for production canaries.
Alerts: PagerDuty P1 when auto-revert is triggered or when cohort-risk-score > 5 for 3 consecutive 1-minute buckets.
Logging: decisions written to rollout-decision-log with context: top-3 prompt regressors, request IDs sample, baseline snapshot.
Observability: Console panels for (a) Golden prompt coverage over time, (b) Top 50 prompt regressors, (c) Decision timeline with annotations.
